text: {"components": [{"type": "entity", "quote": "Section de terminologie des Services linguistiques centraux de la Chancellerie fédérale", "gist": "Terminology section of the central language services of the Federal Chancellery"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Andrea Arcidiacono", "gist": "Andrea Arcidiacono"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Secteur communication et stratégie", "gist": "Communication and strategy sector"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Section communication", "gist": "Communication section"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Section de soutien à la communication", "gist": "Communication support section"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "La Section de terminologie des Services linguistiques centraux de la Chancellerie fédérale élabore pour toute l’administration fédérale une terminologie actualisée et adaptée dans les quatre langues nationales et en anglais.", "gist": "The Terminology Section of the Federal Chancellery's central language services develops updated and adapted terminology for the entire federal administration in the four national languages and in English."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "La section communication de la Chancellerie fédérale coordonne les informations du Conseil fédéral destinées aux médias, au grand public, aux cantons et au Parlement.", "gist": "The Federal Chancellery's communication section coordinates the Federal Council's information for the media, the general public, the cantons, and Parliament."}]}
